progress.command:
gh "pr" "create" "--title" "feat: give pi-durable extensions an image processor" "--body" "Refs #55.

pit 0.36.2 takes an `images` option, an `ImageProcessor`, for `workspace.viewImage` on pi-durable hosts (cv/pit#365). Without one, pit attaches PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images within the byte limit as they are, and rejects larger ones.

- `createDurableExtensions` creates one pi-durable `createNodePhotonImages()` processor and passes it to every extension as `images` in the host options. Its worker thread starts with the first image and exits when idle.
- `DurableHostOptions` has the new `images` member. The tests check that every extension gets the same processor.
- `docs/extensions.md`: the host options table lists `images`.

pi-action's own `read` (`CodingTools`) still has no processor; that is unchanged here.

`npm run check` passes."
